subject: SIG assessor follow-up: PR sampling request & ephemeral keystore rotation
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@assessorco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG evidence follow-up: PR sampling request and keystore rotation

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the SIG intake packet. A couple of quick follow-ups from our assessor team as we scope the control validation for Clearsight Financial: 

1) We need a short PR sampling list (CSV or link) showing the PRs you use for merge gating and code review sampling for the last 6 months. Please include repo name, PR id, author, and brief reason selected.

2) For secrets/keystore controls: we need the playbook or runbook that describes the keystore transfer/rotation process when moving keys between environments (redacted OK), and a recent CI job run snapshot that shows ephemeral credential issuance in the pipeline.

Attachments: sig-questionnaire-ref.pdf (for context)

Timing: If you can provide the material by EOD Wednesday 2026-08-18 that keeps us on track for next-week validation calls.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Liu
Senior Assessor, AssessorCo
emma.liu@assessorco.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@assessorco.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence follow-up: PR sampling request and keystore rotation

Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can provide a redacted PR sampling CSV and a CI job snapshot showing ephemeral token issuance. For the keystore transfer playbook, I will loop in Karthik (keystore owner) for a redacted PDF that documents the transfer and HSM handoff steps. 

Plan and timeline: 
- Today: I will export a candidate PR sampling list and attach a short CSV for initial review.
- Tomorrow (08/17): Karthik will produce a redacted keystore_transfer_playbook.pdf and include the HSM/operator checklist.
- Tomorrow: we will attach a CI snapshot (ci-job-run-snapshot.txt) showing the ephemeral key/token creation step (redacted secrets).

Karthik — can you confirm we are comfortable sharing the redacted playbook and whether we want to include a small note about our KV cache prefix behavior (we often cache transient key handles in runtime, which is relevant to the control assessment)?

Attachments: pr-sample-list.csv, ci-job-run-snapshot.txt (redacted)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance (on rotation)
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@assessorco.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence follow-up: PR sampling request and keystore rotation

Hi all —

Thanks for the heads up. I attached a redacted keystore_transfer_playbook.pdf that covers: operator approvals, HSM handoff checklist, transfer verification steps, and rotation cadence. Key notes for the assessor: 
- We use HSM-backed key material for production signing; transfers between environments require dual-operator approval and an automated verification job that checks key fingerprints post-import.
- Ephemeral tokens are issued by our CI token service for runner-level tasks; the CI snapshot shows the issuance event (token id only, no secret).
- Implementation detail: at runtime we do maintain a short-lived KV cache for transient key handles and KV-cache eviction is part of our rotation script; this is documented in section 5.2 of the playbook.

I have redacted operator usernames and internal ticket numbers. If the assessor needs raw logs for any particular transfer event, we can pull those under an NDA/data request process.

Attachments: keystore_transfer_playbook.pdf

Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
